authorization: User requested the Claude review corrections: register and run three zero-model full 6DOF fixture preflights before any further hosted-model trial.
sensing: Same registered stage-2 accelerometer, per-seed bias, throttle/availability telemetry and quantized fuel gauge, seed 0; estimator consumes only arrived samples. No fault label enters a model request. Ideal kinematics remain a limitation.

request_routing.burn_anomaly: Advisory burn-monitor choice; it does not affect later automatic numerical preparation and is excluded from AI control completion.
request_routing.complete_fault: DeepSeek compares observed estimate, uncertainty and prepared adoption/continuation previews; action and numerical-reference IDs only
request_routing.normal_complete: One-action monitor; normal final-state equality proves no extra intervention, not planning choice.

application.change: one replacement of only model-vehicle landing-engine limits; actual plant remains unchanged
application.time_semantics: Measured prediction/check/model wall duration must fit the fixed 600-second reserved coast interval. Physical actual-plant integration advances through that whole interval with the unchanged controller, then consumes the receipt at the first scheduled control step. This is a finite simulator workflow, not hard-real-time flight certification.

numerical_preparation.switch_value: numeric point estimate, never model-written factor
numerical_preparation.continue_previews: reuse only already-reviewed Git-tracked step2 request material when observation and complete estimate exactly match; no private raw-record import; no execution authority
numerical_preparation.no_response_reuse: reuse first-case adoption forecasts only when snapshot hash, estimate point, band point, application time and record hash exactly match; no repeated physics
numerical_preparation.scope: three points, not a continuous-band guarantee
numerical_preparation.all_reused_forecasts: First stopped cohort forecasts reverified and reused only after exact producer-source/backend, snapshot, estimate/band, record hash and scheduled-time checks

independent_check.process: separate credential-free Python process, strict JSON
checks: registered actual file SHA and installed backend
causal telemetry re-estimation and estimate ID
prediction inputs/switches and independently reconstructed contact arithmetic
every control step ordered and uses assumed model; every physical step uses plant
one-use receipt consumed at fresh current state
independent_check.claim: independent contract and arithmetic checks; shared-model forecasts are not independent physical-model validation

fallback.missing_or_invalid_model_judgment: adopt numeric point estimate only through the same passed guard and preapproved scope
fallback.valid_continue_judgment: retain judgment; do not override merely to obtain a successful landing
fallback.guard_failed_or_late: no adoption; retain nominal execution and dangerous/unresolved outcome, with no safe-return claim

pass_conditions: fault_live in fixture mode: accepted explicitly labelled fixture adoption, no fallback, independent guard pass, receipt/switch once and contact gates pass; no AI completion claim
fault_no_response: no calls or accepted fixture action, checked fallback and one-use adoption with contact pass
normal_live in fixture mode: accepted continue only, no switch, final state/outcome exactly saved nominal, contact pass
every case: model attempts and inference zero, source/backend fixed, compressed records restored and reverified; three full physical suffixes, zero new forecasts
comparison: Reuse saved assumed-100%/actual-80% no-intervention flight (9.16575255358686 m/s); no Rules-score comparison and no new comparator rollout. Do not extrapolate from one state or tune the scenario after live results.

result_actions_ordered.when: invalid record/source/input/backend/budget or preflight gate not met
result_actions_ordered.next: retain all completed/partial records and stop; no model call and no automatic retry
report preflight only; actual AI completion remains unproved; prepare a new frozen live plan and wait for its approval

end_preservation: Retain all old failed and prepared plans unchanged; preserve this preflight plan, finite budget ledger, HTTP fixture receipts, separate guard receipts, restored compressed flight records and source snapshots. Do not delete evidence.

original_attempt.result: stopped_after_fault_live: Jev valid, DeepSeek response invalid, verifier indexed 18 engine states into six saved main-thrust values, no adoption, contact 9.16575255358686 m/s
original_attempt.preservation: original source snapshot, failed guard, flight and model attempt remain unchanged
original_attempt.raw_response_not_retained: Legacy-to-canonical model-name mismatch is a likely interface issue; exact cause of the old provider rejection remains unknown

repairs.model: Explicit current canonical deepseek-flash; strict returned-model equality is retained
repairs.diagnostics: Allowlisted model name, model-match bool, choice count, finish reason and response length only; no reasoning/raw response
